reason: Unmaintained, no vulnerability. Only age's translation macros (i18n-embed-fl, i18n-embed-impl) use it, at build time, to read age's own i18n.toml; nothing of ours or a user's is parsed with it.

Timing leaks on secret integers. In age 0.12.1 only the P-256 tag recipients (src/native/tag.rs, tagpq) reach it through p256 and hpke; the password backup uses only the passphrase (scrypt) recipient, so no secret goes through crypto-bigint. The fix is in 0.7.6, which elliptic-curve 0.13 cannot take.
